title: Southern Arizona New Year’s
subtitle: Dec 31 – Jan 3. The border country on New Year’s Day, then the three Cochise County parks on Jan 2 once their visitor centers reopen.

days.title: Fly to Phoenix
days.html:
✈︎

OAK → PHX after work

Southwest WN296 · OAK 7:40 PM PT → PHX 10:40 PM MST. Conf. 2CH258 · Basic fare, seats assigned at check-in, so check in right at the 24-hour mark.

Pick up the rental car at PHX, then 25 min · 22 mi on I-10 W to the Best Western Phoenix Goodyear Inn (55 N Litchfield Rd). Arrive ~11:30 PM. The west side puts you straight onto AZ-85 in the morning.

Navigate to Goodyear ↗
Time zone: Arizona stays on MST all year, one hour ahead of California in winter. Every time in this book is local.
Book around Dec 17: the rental car and all three hotels (Goodyear, Sierra Vista, near PHX).

days.title: Border country
days.cut: Organ Pipe and Tumacácori stay open on New Year’s Day. Services are sparse for about 100 miles after Organ Pipe, so top up gas in Why.

days.title: Cochise County
days.cut: Coronado 8–4, Chiricahua 8:30–4:30, Fort Bowie 8:30–4. All three were closed Jan 1, which is why they’re today. Fort Bowie’s schedule changes often, so recheck the week before.

stops.via: I-10 W to AZ-85 S through Gila Bend, Ajo and Why · 111 mi.
stops.name: Organ Pipe Cactus NM
stops.addr: Organ Pipe Cactus National Monument, 10 Organ Pipe Dr, Ajo, AZ 85321
stops.hrs: Open New Year’s Day; closes only Thanksgiving and Christmas. Posted opening time varies (8 or 9 AM), so confirm in the NPS app.
stops.acc: Accessible paved nature trail behind the visitor center.
stops.about: Protects a stretch of Sonoran Desert where the organ pipe cactus, common in Mexico, grows wild in the U.S. The monument runs right along the border.

stops.via: Leave ~9:45. North on AZ-85, then AZ-86 east across the Tohono O’odham Nation · 166 mi. Top up gas in Why.
stops.name: Tumacácori NHP
stops.addr: Tumacacori National Historical Park, 1891 I-19 Frontage Rd, Tumacacori, AZ 85640
stops.hrs: 9 AM – 5 PM. Open New Year’s Day.
stops.acc: The mission church and grounds are on a short, mostly level path from the museum.
stops.about: Ruins of Spanish colonial missions in the Santa Cruz Valley. The adobe church of San José de Tumacácori was built in the early 1800s and never finished.

stops.via: Leave ~1:15. I-19 S to Rio Rico, AZ-82 E through Patagonia, then AZ-90 to Sierra Vista · 74 mi.
stops.name: Sierra Vista, AZ
stops.addr: Best Western Plus Sun Canyon, 260 N Garden Ave, Sierra Vista, AZ 85635
stops.note: Best Western Plus Sun Canyon, 260 N Garden Ave. Free afternoon. Tomorrow starts at 7:30 AM for Coronado.

stops.name: Coronado N Mem
stops.addr: Coronado National Memorial, 4101 E Montezuma Canyon Rd, Hereford, AZ 85615
stops.hrs: 8 AM – 4 PM. Closed New Year’s Day, which is why it’s on Jan 2.
stops.ok: The visitor center is on the paved section, about 2 mi in. No need to continue up to Montezuma Pass.
stops.about: Commemorates Francisco Vázquez de Coronado’s 1540–42 expedition, which entered what’s now the U.S. near here. It sits right against the Mexican border.

stops.via: Leave ~8:30. AZ-92 to Bisbee, Double Adobe Rd, US-191 N, AZ-181 E · 95 mi.
stops.name: Chiricahua National Park
stops.addr: Chiricahua National Monument Visitor Center, Willcox, AZ
stops.hrs: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM. Closed Jan 1 last year, so Jan 2 is the safe day.
stops.ok: One closer on the 64 national parks list. Bonita Canyon Drive to Massai Point overlook if time allows; it can close for snow and ice.
stops.about: A “Wonderland of Rocks”: thousands of rhyolite pinnacles and balanced rocks left by a huge volcanic eruption about 27 million years ago.

stops.via: Leave ~11:00. AZ-181 W, AZ-186 W, then gravel Apache Pass Rd to the trailhead · 28 mi.
stops.name: Fort Bowie NHS
stops.place: Trailhead on Apache Pass Rd, Bowie
stops.addr: Fort Bowie National Historic Site, 3500 S Apache Pass Rd, Bowie, AZ 85605
stops.hrs: Fri – Mon, 8:30 AM – 4 PM. Saturday is covered, but recheck the week before.
stops.warn: The visitor center is a 1.5 mi walk each way from the trailhead. Back at the car around 2:15.
stops.acc: Call the park at 520-847-2500 to ask about drive-in access to the visitor center for visitors with limited mobility.
stops.about: Guarded Apache Pass and its spring, a key water source on the Butterfield stage route. The adobe ruins recall the long conflict with the Chiricahua Apache under Cochise and Geronimo.

stops.via: Leave ~2:15, off the gravel road in daylight. Apache Pass Rd to Bowie, then I-10 W · 229 mi.
stops.name: Phoenix, near the airport
stops.note: Hotel close to PHX for the early flight (book around Dec 17). Set an alarm: the car goes back at ~4:15 AM.

stops.via: Return the rental car by ~4:15 AM.
stops.title: Phoenix → home
stops.note: Southwest WN3468 · PHX 5:30 AM MST → OAK 6:30 AM PT. Conf. 2CH258.
